name: IdeaPad Slim 3
description: A simple and affordable laptop for everyday student work. It handles documents, browsing, and online classes without any trouble.

name: VivoBook 15
description: A large screen budget laptop that is comfortable for writing reports and watching lectures. The keyboard is roomy and easy to type on.

name: Aspire 5
description: A no-nonsense student laptop with a solid processor. Storage is smaller, so it suits cloud users and light note taking.

name: 250 G9
description: The cheapest option in our list. It is good enough for taking notes, writing assignments, and browsing the web.

name: ThinkPad E14
description: A business style ultrabook with a tough body and a great keyboard. It is light enough to carry to every lecture.

name: Inspiron 14
description: A well balanced everyday ultrabook. It has enough memory for multitasking between a browser, docs, and a chat app.

name: Zenbook 14
description: A very light ultrabook with a sharp screen and a long battery life. It easily lasts a full day on campus.

name: MacBook Air M2
description: A silent and cool ultrabook with a fantastic battery. It is a favorite among students who read and write a lot.

name: MacBook Air M3
description: The newest MacBook Air with even better battery life. It is light, fast, and quiet during long study sessions.

name: Pavilion Plus 14
description: A powerful processor inside a small body. Good for students who run heavier programs alongside their coursework.

name: Swift Go 14
description: A slim ultrabook that charges fast and carries easily. A good middle ground between price and features.

name: Galaxy Book4
description: A bright screen and a light body make this a nice study laptop. It works well with Samsung phones if you have one.

name: TUF Gaming F15
description: A sturdy gaming laptop with a fast screen. It plays modern games well, but the charger is required for long sessions.

name: Katana 15
description: A straightforward gaming machine with plenty of storage. Great for students who game after their deadlines.

name: Nitro V 15
description: A budget gaming laptop that runs most games at good settings. A popular pick for first year students.

name: Victus 16
description: A big screen gaming laptop with a strong AMD processor. The large display is nice for design work too.

name: Legion 5 Pro
description: A high end gaming laptop with lots of memory. It also works well for engineering software and heavy projects.

name: Blade 15
description: A premium gaming laptop with a clean design. It is fast and well built, but the price is high.

name: Surface Pro 9
description: A tablet that works like a laptop with the keyboard cover. Very light and great for taking notes with a pen.

name: Zenbook Flip 14
description: A laptop with a screen that folds all the way back. You can use it as a tablet for drawing or reading.

name: Yoga 7i
description: A flexible 2-in-1 with a touch screen. It is a good choice for students who like to read in tablet mode.

name: Envy x360
description: A convertible laptop with a smooth hinge and a bright touch screen. It fits easily in a small backpack.

name: XPS 15
description: A creator laptop with a very accurate screen. It is a strong choice for photo editing and coding projects.

name: MacBook Pro 14
description: A creator laptop with a stunning display and a battery that lasts all day. Ideal for video and design students.
